camel_example: aliyun alidns DescribeDomainInfo --region cn-hangzhou --NeedDetailAttributes true --DomainName 'example.com' --Lang en
description_en: Queries information about a specified domain name
description_zh: 根据传入参数查询指定域名的信息
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-domain-info --lang en --domain-name example.com --need-detail-attributes true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainInfo

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：
- zh：中文
- en：英文

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The domain name. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2357286.html to obtain the domain name
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return detailed attributes of the domain name. Valid values:

- true

- false

The default value is false.

If you set this parameter to **true**, the response includes the following parameters: lineType, minTtl, recordLineTreeJson, recordLines, lineCode, lineDisplayName, lineName, regionLines, and slaveDns
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回域名详细的属性，取值范围：
- true：
- false 

默认值：false，不需要细节属性。

当值为**true**时，则返回以下数据：lineType、minTtl、recordLineTreeJson、recordLines、lineCode、lineDisplayName、lineName、regionLines、slaveDns
parameters.name: need_detail_attributes
